title: Wishlist: Option to reduce sidebar size in the kick off menu
line: Application Launcher has a new "Show sidebar labels" option; turning it off shows the sidebar categories and tabs as icons only, leaving more room for apps.
explanation: Kickoff's category sidebar and its Applications/Places footer tabs always showed text labels, and the sidebar width is tied to the width of those tabs, so about a third of the popup goes to the sidebar. There was no way to make it narrower. The change adds a showSidebarLabels setting (default on, so nothing changes by default); when it's off the sidebar categories and the two footer tabs show only their icons, with the names as tooltips, the user name next to the avatar is hidden, and the sidebar shrinks to icon width.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: add an option to show only icons in the sidebar

The category sidebar and its Applications and Places tabs always showed
text labels, taking a lot of the popup's width. Add a "Show sidebar
labels" option; when it's off they show icons with the names as tooltips.

BUG: 512190

patches.diff:
From a0ec856d5add95b2fedeb1cacfbfe687962f29ee Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 21:32:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: add an option to show only icons in the
 sidebar

The category sidebar and its Applications and Places tabs always showed
text labels, taking a lot of the popup's width. Add a "Show sidebar
labels" option; when it's off they show icons with the names as tooltips.

BUG: 512190
---
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml       |  6 ++++++
 applets/kickoff/Footer.qml              | 10 ++++++++++
 applets/kickoff/Header.qml              |  1 +
 applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml |  5 ++++-
 applets/kickoff/main.xml                |  4 ++++
 5 files changed, 25 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..8d4eb6c75a 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -39,6 +39,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_compactMode: compactModeCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_highlightNewlyInstalledApps: highlightNewlyInstalledAppsCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_switchCategoryOnHover: switchCategoryOnHoverCheckbox.checked
+    property alias cfg_showSidebarLabels: showSidebarLabelsCheckbox.checked
 
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
         QQC2.Button {
@@ -220,6 +221,11 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             checked: Plasmoid.configuration.paneSwap
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showSidebarLabelsCheckbox
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show sidebar labels")
+        }
+
         QQC2.RadioButton {
             id: showFavoritesInGrid
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group prefix for radio button group", "Show favorites:")
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/Footer.qml b/applets/kickoff/Footer.qml
index 593b5ebac4..685a17c08c 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/Footer.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/Footer.qml
@@ -8,10 +8,12 @@
 pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Templates as T
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PC3
 import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 
 PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
     id: root
@@ -99,6 +101,10 @@ PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
             icon.height: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium
             icon.name: "applications-all-symbolic"
             text: i18nc("@title:tab kickoff sidebar tab", "Applications")
+            display: Plasmoid.configuration.showSidebarLabels ? T.AbstractButton.TextBesideIcon : T.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+            PC3.ToolTip.text: text
+            PC3.ToolTip.visible: display === T.AbstractButton.IconOnly && hovered
+            PC3.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
             Keys.onBacktabPressed: event => {
                 (kickoff.lastCentralPane || nextItemInFocusChain(false))
                     .forceActiveFocus(Qt.BacktabFocusReason)
@@ -115,6 +121,10 @@ PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
             icon.height: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium
             icon.name: "compass"
             text: i18nc("@title:tab kickoff sidebar tab", "Places") //Explore?
+            display: Plasmoid.configuration.showSidebarLabels ? T.AbstractButton.TextBesideIcon : T.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+            PC3.ToolTip.text: text
+            PC3.ToolTip.visible: display === T.AbstractButton.IconOnly && hovered
+            PC3.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
         }
 
         Connections {
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/Header.qml b/applets/kickoff/Header.qml
index 300654df9e..4cc48edd5e 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/Header.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/Header.qml
@@ -122,6 +122,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
                 MouseArea {
                     id: nameAndInfoMouseArea
                     hoverEnabled: true
+                    visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showSidebarLabels
 
                     Layout.fillHeight: true
                     Layout.fillWidth: true
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
index 4e3d57fab4..b79b582af6 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@ AbstractKickoffItemDelegate {
     id: root
 
     property bool compact: Plasmoid.configuration.compactMode
+    readonly property bool iconOnly: isCategoryListItem && !Plasmoid.configuration.showSidebarLabels
 
     leftPadding: KickoffSingleton.listItemMetrics.margins.left
         + (mirrored ? KickoffSingleton.fontMetrics.descent : 0)
@@ -35,7 +36,7 @@ AbstractKickoffItemDelegate {
     icon.width: compact || root.isCategoryListItem ? Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
     icon.height: compact || root.isCategoryListItem ? Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
 
-    labelTruncated: label.truncated
+    labelTruncated: label.truncated || iconOnly
     descriptionTruncated: descriptionLabel.truncated
     descriptionVisible: descriptionLabel.visible
 
@@ -50,6 +51,7 @@ AbstractKickoffItemDelegate {
             implicitWidth: root.icon.width
             implicitHeight: root.icon.height
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter
+            Layout.fillWidth: root.iconOnly
 
             animated: false
             selected: root.iconAndLabelsShouldlookSelected
@@ -61,6 +63,7 @@ AbstractKickoffItemDelegate {
 
             implicitHeight: gridLayout.implicitHeight
             Layout.fillWidth: true
+            visible: !root.iconOnly
 
             GridLayout {
                 id: gridLayout
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.xml b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
index 8f6a44e2a4..4865e5dc2f 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.xml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
@@ -65,6 +65,10 @@
             <label>Whether to use a compact display style for list items</label>
             <default>false</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="showSidebarLabels" type="Bool">
+            <label>Whether to display text labels for the sidebar categories and tabs, or only their icons</label>
+            <default>true</default>
+        </entry>
         <entry name="switchCategoryOnHover" type="Bool">
             <label>Whether to allow switching category items on hover</label>
             <default>false</default>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Kickoff today: the sidebar with category names takes about a third of the popup
With "Show sidebar labels" off: categories and tabs are icons only and the favorites area gets the space
Hovering a category shows its name as a tooltip
The new checkbox under "Sidebar position" in the launcher settings
